cards.title: 2.1 The cause of French revolution
body: The causes of the French Revolution include both long-term problems and immediate events.
The long-term causes are to be found in the unjust foundations of French society.

cards.title: 2.2 Course of the revolution
body: The Estates-General was composed of representatives from the three Estates of French society.
The First and Second Estates had about three hundred delegates each.

cards.title: Exam answer plan: Napoleon’s rise
cards.problem: How did Napoleon Bonaparte come to power?

steps.text: Background: the Directory (1795–1799) was weak and unpopular.
Napoleon won fame through military victories, especially in Italy.

cards.answer: In 1799 he took power in a coup and became First Consul; in 1804 he crowned himself emperor.
